mentions.name: Git Tower replacement (Git GUI)
mentions.description: A desktop Git GUI application built as a personal replacement for Git Tower, aiming to provide all the features of modern Git graphical clients.
mentions.problem: Git Tower version 2, used for about 8 years, is aging and the newer versions require a subscription the author refuses to pay.
mentions.source_excerpt: Building myself a replacement for Git Tower. I've been using version 2 for about 8 years now, refusing to pay a subscription for the newer versions. It's finally getting long in the tooth, so building myself a new application that does all the things the modern git GUIs can do.
mentions.author: Jeremy1026
